name: Pacifidlog Town
lines:
The sea between Pacifidlog and Slateport has a
swift-running current.
If you try to Surf there, you might end up
swept away somewhere else.

Look! Look! Isn’t it neat?
Our houses are on water!
And I was born here, too!

The folks of Pacifidlog make their living
by fishing and diving.

Pacifidlog Town
Where the morning sun smiles upon the waters.
